trial_court: III Addl.Judge, Family Court, Bangalore - M.C.No.769/2007
case_name: Smt C Krishnaveni D/O Sri. C. ... vs Sri D Ramesh S/O Late Subramanian

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt C Krishnaveni, D/o Sri C.Chandrase1<.ar
parties.respondent_defendant: Sri D Ramesh S/O Late Subramanian

facts_of_case: The appellant filed a petition for dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(i) of the Hindu Marriage Act. The trial court allowed the petition and granted permanent alimony to the appellant. The present appeal is filed against this judgment.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse who deserts the other without reasonable cause is not entitled to maintenance.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that a spouse who deserts the other without reasonable cause is not entitled to maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to prove that he has not deserted the appellant.
legal_principles.held: The burden lies on the respondent to prove that he has not deserted the appellant, and if he fails to do so, the court can infer desertion.

outcome.final_order: The court granted liberty to the appellant to withdraw the appeal with liberty to avail other remedies to claim maintenance for herself and her children.
